description: Use first when you found an AI or software URL elsewhere (a release note, repo, blog post, tweet) and want to know if it is new: returns New Runtime records that cite that exact URL, related records and patterns, the source's hub, and next steps. Free, no auth. Example: {"url": "https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers", "task": "is this new?"}.

task.description: Optional: what you are trying to find out; its words refine related records.

url.description: The https:// URL you are researching.

name: contextualize_url
title: Contextualize an outside URL
